summary: No box all round: box.py rent was refused on the fleet budget pace on every try from 17:32 to 03:46 UTC (~385 tries; two boxes held 0.59 of a ~0.615 $/h limit), so no run and no eval (score.py: 0 valid evals). Built, tested and pushed (default off, flag-off bit-identical): --stall-energy EPS (energy height z+|v|^2/2g re-arms the training stall timer and un-stagnates pumping states for the reservoir), --eval-patience-energy 1 (the same channel for the eval patience rule), --energy-pot-rel 1 (energy shaping in the field's own unit); tools/warm_from_ref.py, tools/eval_energy_report.py, tools/zl_watch.sh. Analysis: the field pays the first loop at its turnarounds (record 8.7% at 32 s); none of the four refs pumps zero-shot. Next: zlr1b1_en (scratch, recipe + --energy-pot 1 --energy-pot-rel 1 --energy-pot-front 0 --energy-pot-front-bonus 0 --stall-energy 32 --eval-patience-energy 1) and zlr1b1_wen (same, warm from uf2_x13) side by side, then the plain recipe as the control (NOTES.md has the commands).
